out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean EQUIPMENT, KITCHENWARE were stored DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN KITCHEN AND FRONT SERVICE AREA that exposed the item (s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO STORE EQUIPMENT AND KITCHENWARE 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of BEANS, SPICES AND CONDIMENTS ON BACK STORAGE SHELVING.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE FOOD SAFE NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS FOR FOODF STORAGE.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location

violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO STORE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.
